One original square English grammar teaching vignette, high-detail richly colored Japanese editorial anime with realistic everyday proportions, expressive faces, beautifully painted setting, clear objects and warm daylight or evening light appropriate to the scene. No readable words, letters, digits, dates, logos, watermark, speech-bubble text or invented scores. Exact grammar and roles are supplied in selectable HTML beside each picture. The scene is an illustrative teaching example, not additional facts or a photograph from the original exercise. This exercise asks how long a phone conversation has lasted up to now; the follow-up asks if the caller is thirsty. Anonymous young adult caller has short dark hair and a blue hoodie, no fixed gender claim in the question. Keep this caller recognizable. Do not depict a definite number of minutes or a fixed time. A caller in a blue hoodie talks on a smartphone in a cozy living room, still actively engaged, while an unobtrusive round clock with a blank face and simple hands on the wall suggests time passing. Medium-wide side view, phone clearly against the ear and no ended-call screen. The focus is an activity continuing up to the current moment, not a completed event yesterday.
